summary.learning_goal: Reveal reactor components and trace direct-cycle steam and separate cooling water.
summary.primary_visualization: Three coordinated views: power block, simplified steam circuit, and reactor in motion.
summary.primary_interaction: Disassemble the plant, change explanatory view, pause motion and cut through layers.

strengths: The source dialog discloses simplified proportions, channel counts, paired loops and open cut surfaces.
The broad direct-cycle relationship agrees with the cited official plant description.
weaknesses: Exact model geometry and detailed component claims were not audited.

strengths: Architecture, thermodynamics and operation are separated into clear explanatory views with consistent labels.
weaknesses: Short captions identify components but provide limited explanations of their roles; there is no learner-controlled thermodynamic experiment.

strengths: Disassembly exposes layered shielding and graphite; circuit colors distinguish water and steam.
weaknesses: The upper page and panel leave some important geometry below the initial 900px viewport; section-cut endpoints can remove too much context.

strengths: Disassembly, tab changes, pause status and section cutting produced distinct observed states.
weaknesses: Playback and clipping change inspection, not reactor physics; not every visibility switch was tested.

strengths: Consistent grid, restrained colors and grouped controls give a coherent exhibit identity.
weaknesses: Desktop content extends below the initial viewport and secondary labels are small; mobile controls require additional scrolling.

top_weaknesses: Some geometry lies below the initial fold
principles_to_learn: Use separate views for spatial structure and flow relationships.
Maintain consistent labels and color meaning across modes.
State simplifications next to the visualization and link primary sources.
Allow learners to pause and expose hidden layers.
things_not_to_copy: Do not imply that animated flow speed is physical operating speed.
Do not make a conceptual model appear to be an exact engineering replica.
golden_recommendation: Use for exploded view, linked explanatory modes, flow playback, section cut. Use principles with the documented limitations.
